answer:
**Your project as understood:** An eco-village of 15–25 homes with shared gardens and one collective wastewater system, on farmland just outside a village in Mora kommun — location only roughly indicated, with no ownership deal, survey or technical investigations yet.

**What could block it:**
- **A new group of 15–25 homes is "sammanhållen bebyggelse", which must be examined through a detaljplan.** PBL 4 kap. 2 § obliges the kommun to test suitability with a detaljplan for "en ny sammanhållen bebyggelse med bygglovspliktiga byggnadsverk" when the character, scale or impact of the settlement, or the need for coordination, requires it [c:701183a84b4afc0f]. At this scale individual bygglov outside a plan is not a realistic route: bygglov outside a detaljplan is only possible where the measure does not presuppose planning under 4 kap. 2 or 3 § (PBL 9 kap. 57 §) [c:01156e3238dfc9f8].
- **Farmland status.** Jordbruksmark (åker- och betesmark on a fastighet taxed as a lantbruksenhet) is protected under MB 12 kap. 7–9 §§ [c:10dac4e4d328e52a; c:5ff487a4cf21124e], and brukningsvärd jordbruksmark may only be taken for bebyggelse if it is needed for väsentliga samhällsintressen and cannot reasonably be met on other land (MB 3 kap. 4 §) [c:5e037b653f0fcde5]. Note the built-in solution: the protections in 12 kap. 8–9 §§ do not apply to land that "i en detaljplan … är avsedd för ett annat ändamål än jordbruk" [c:10dac4e4d328e52a], and the notification duty to länsstyrelsen does not apply where the use's legality has been specially examined (i.e. through the plan/bygglov route) (MB 12 kap. 9 §) [c:5ff487a4cf21124e]. A detaljplan therefore legally converts the farmland — but the kommun must still be willing to start one, and it will weigh kulturlandskap/jordbruksvärden.
- **Strandskydd, riksintressen and other spatial overlays.** Much of Mora is within strandskydd and the Siljan riksintresse; the kommun's LIS-plan (tematiskt tillägg to the översiktsplan) says new buildings should be avoided where bebyggelse is absent or sparse, and that within LIS-områden strandskydd remains until a dispens or a plan lifts it [c:0b1a73750cec838c; c:9bded3b53808c71a]. Whether your site is affected can only be checked in Mora's Bygglovskartan [c:5144f41cc56d6d88].
- **Wastewater.** One shared plant for 15–25 households (roughly 60–100 pe) sits well below Mora's 200 pe ceiling for enskilt avlopp, but an avloppsanordning that receives WC water requires a permit from the kommunal nämnd (FMH 13 §) [c:5ad3694cc417eb29], and wastewater must be cleaned so no harm arises (MB 9 kap. 7 §) [c:33eb278f6bffb0a7]. If the site proves to be inside a kommunalt verksamhetsområde, connection instead of enskilt avlopp may be required — Mora's planbeskrivningar show sites where "Moravatten har inga planer på att förse området" and enskilt løsning applies [c:925e4dee2c8be705].
- **Land title and shared facilities.** Fifteen to twenty-five separately owned homes with shared gardens and shared VA means you will need samfällighet / gemensamhetsanläggning structures: a gemensamhetsanläggning is "anläggning som är gemensam för flera fastigheter … av stadigvarande betydelse" (Anläggningslag 1 §) [c:5380583d298c434b], samfällighet is common land of several fastigheter (FBL 3 §) [c:0035a854779122ed], and the participants form a special samfällighet for operation and maintenance (AL 14 §) [c:ae8de25be77bca00] with a duty to set aside a maintenance fund (LFS 19 §) [c:fa37058c2d3f5b53]. Without a title/ownership structure, neither plots nor the shared plant can be financed or sold.
- **Översiktsplan alignment.** Mora's kommuntäckande översiktsplan (2006, aktualitetsförklarad 2017) governs where there is no detaljplan, and the planbesked test is explicitly "en avstämning mot översiktsplanen, eventuell gällande detaljplan och annat planeringsunderlag så som trafikstrategi, teknisk infrastruktur och hållbarhet" [c:022b3a05cc4e6e58; c:4c8a348725376aed].

**Ways to make it work:**
- **Route 1 — planbesked → detaljplan → bygglov (the realistic route for this scale).** Apply for planbesked (PBL 5 kap. 2 §: kommunen must state its intent to start planning) [c:72b182d1aced1865; c:54d1b737d5241943]. Mora decides within four months of a complete application, the fee covers self-cost and varies with complexity, and if the kommun proceeds you sign a planavtal where "fastighetsägaren står för avgiften att upprätta detaljplanen" [c:4c8a348725376aed]. A typical Mora detaljplan takes about a year, longer for larger ones [c:c8bf22fff202fee7]. Precedent: a plan for ~20 small houses on 5.6 ha at Selbäcksvägen/Morkarlby, drafted by Miljö- och byggnadsförvaltningen Mora Orsa and taken through samråd in Feb–Mar 2026 — exactly your scale [c:e83ad38305574308].
- **Route 2 — phase it downwards.** If the kommun balks at 25 homes, structure the plan to allow a first phase of e.g. 8–10 households (or a gemensamhetsanläggning for VA + gemensam gård serving a smaller number), with room for extension. The plan must not be larger than needed for its purpose (PBL 4 kap. 32 §) [c:8f76fb82bf950155], so a phased, well-argued plan is easier to defend; shared facilities are legally accommodated as a gemensamhetsanläggning (AL 1 §) [c:5380583d298c434b].
- **Route 3 — förhandsbesked first, if you only want certainty about one or a few buildings.** Mora's förhandsbesked tests markens lämplighet, teknisk infrastruktur and natur-/kulturvärden; a positive decision binds the byggnadsnämnd to grant bygglov if applied for within 2 years, decided within 10 weeks of a complete application [c:3195c31dd25c2235]. For a 15–25 home village this only helps as a supplement — it does not replace the detaljplan [c:01156e3238dfc9f8].
- **Design the eco-village to fit the plan documents.** Keep the footprint compact (leave brukningsvärd åkermark outside the plan area, keep cultivated land as the shared gardens), avoid strandskydd/rik interests where possible, place the plant where infiltration tests pass, and provide for dagvatten and access road in the plan — the Selbäcksvägen precedent shows Mora accepting plans that combine housing, local roads and dagvattenhantering [c:e83ad38305574308].

**Suggested path:**
1. Pin down the exact site: fastighetsbeteckning(s), whether one or several fastigheter, current ownership, and whether a detaljplan already covers it — check Mora's Bygglovskartan for detaljplan, strandskydd, LIS-plan, kulturvärden and risk areas [c:5144f41cc56d6d88].
2. Make the ownership side real before anything else: an option/köpepakt on the land, plus a view on how plots will be titled (delning/samfällighet) and how the shared gardens and plant will be owned [c:0035a854779122ed; c:ae8de25be77bca00].
3. Early dialogue with Miljö- och byggnadsförvaltningen Mora Orsa, planenheten (planbesked) and the miljöenhet (avlopp) — Mora explicitly advises taking contact early on wastewater [c:ea5e79a1a763be79]. Contact: miljobygg@mora.se, 0250-260 00 [c:94cd71a1b41a6a7d].
4. Submit a planbesked application (PBL 5 kap. 2–3 §): purpose, affected area on a map, character and approximate scale of the buildings [c:54d1b737d5241943]; expect a decision within four months and a fee set at self-cost [c:4c8a348725376aed].
5. In parallel, commission the technical studies the plan will demand: mark infiltrationsförmåga (siktsurva/perkolation) and grundvattennivå for the plant, grundvatten/brand/trafik, cultural-heritage overview — Mora's avlopp process requires infiltration and groundwater investigations attached to the application [c:e089ae26d679d46a].
6. If a positive planbesked comes: sign the planavtal, develop the detaljplan (roughly a year or more: samråd → granskning → kommunfullmäktige) [c:c8bf22fff202fee7; c:efc414ccc8de1275; c:a29f75396aa3e707], then apply for bygglov per building and for the avloppstillstånd.
7. Wastewater permit: apply via Mora's e-service for an avloppsanläggning (up to 200 pe), fee corresponding to 8 hours' handling, ~6–8 weeks, with referral to Nodava AB and neighbours; do not dig before the Miljö- och byggnadsnämnd decision has entered into force [c:e089ae26d679d46a; c:94cd71a1b41a6a7d; c:c86c6390cc2f5783]. Handläggning of a private avlopp case is 9 536 kr [c:c86c6390cc2f5783].

**Questions for you:**
- Which village/fastighet is the rough location — fastighetsbeteckning or nearest ort? This decides strandskydd/LIS, existing detaljplan, and whether the översiktsplan supports growth there.
- Is the land still brukningsvärd åkermark and owned by one party, or several? Are you buying as individuals, a förening, or an andels-/kooperativ form?
- Is the site inside or outside a kommunalt verksamhetsområde for vatten/avlopp (checkable against Mora's vattentjänstplan) — this decides enskilt avlopp vs connection [c:d03abc56c67b17c7; c:925e4dee2c8be705].
- How many pe do you expect, and do the homes share one plant only, or also gårdsytor/other facilities (affects samfällighet design)?
- What is your budget and timeline for the plan process — planbesked fee plus planavtal means the property owner pays for the detaljplan [c:4c8a348725376aed].

**Uncertainties:**
- The corpus does not contain the full text of the 2006 översiktsplan (only its description and the LIS/TÖP and FÖP Mora tätort supplements), so I could not verify what the översiktsplan says about new housing "just outside a village" at your specific site; check the delområde recommendations in Bygglovskartan or ask the planenheten [c:022b3a05cc4e6e58].
- No site-specific data was available: strandskydd extent, fornlämningar, flood/ras-risk, VA capacity and mark infiltration at your location all remain to be confirmed in the Bygglovskartan and by the technical studies above.
- The exact planbesked fee amount is not stated on Mora's page (only that it follows self-cost and varies with complexity) [c:4c8a348725376aed]; current bygglov/plan fees should be taken from Mora's taxa.

answer:
**Your project as understood:** A market garden on the edge of a village in Mörbylånga kommun — a large greenhouse, a farm shop, and two homes for the growers, most likely partly on agricultural land and possibly partly outside any detaljplan. The greenhouse and shop are "verksamhet", the two homes are the legally hardest element.

**What could block it**

- **The two homes + shop together look like new settlement.** Bygglov outside a detaljplan must be given only if the measure does *not* "förutsätta planläggning enligt 4 kap. 2 eller 3 §" (PBL 9 kap. 57 §) [c:01156e3238dfc9f8]. PBL 4 kap. 2 § obliges the kommun to examine with a detaljplan, among other things, "en ny sammanhållen bebyggelse" and buildings that may have "betydande inverkan på omgivningen" [c:701183a84b4afc0f; c:1a9b7f2f6378a055]. A cluster of two new dwellings plus a customer-facing shop on the village edge can be judged to require planning — then no bygglov is possible until a detaljplan exists. Note the saving clause: "Trots första stycket 4 krävs det ingen detaljplan om byggnadsverket kan prövas i samband med en prövning av ansökan om bygglov eller förhandsbesked" [c:1a9b7f2f6378a055] — that is the doorway you want to argue your way through, if it fits.
- **Agricultural land.** "Brukningsvärd jordbruksmark får tas i anspråk för bebyggelse eller anläggningar endast om det behövs för att tillgodose väsentliga samhällsintressen och detta behov inte kan tillgodosas på ett … tillfredsställande sätt genom att annan mark tas i anspråk" (MB 3 kap. 4 §) [c:5e037b653f0fcde5]. PBL 2 kap. 4 § adds that land may be taken for building only if it is suitable for the purpose [c:59e5bac508736b1a]. Buildings should therefore go on the least valuable soil, keeping the productive area in cultivation. Also, taking jordbruksmark out of production can require anmälan to länsstyrelsen unless the case has been examined "i särskild ordning" (MB 12 kap. 9 §) [c:5ff487a4cf21124e] — a detaljplan/bygglov route normally covers that.
- **The farm shop.** In Mörbylånga "behöver du alltid bygglov för att bygga en ny verksamhetslokal" [c:e427da6e7d69c525], and converting a dwelling to butik/verksamhet always needs bygglov [c:6a8fbbb3dfa0984b]. The application can require parkeringsutredning, tillgänglighetsutlåtande, dagvattenutredning, bullerutredning and brandskyddsbeskrivning [c:440ff61b6726258b] — these are the studies you have not yet budgeted for. (A detaljplan may regulate trade, but "endast om det finns skäl av betydande vikt" — PBL 4 kap. 37 § [c:551b697e805e1fbe], so trade is not automatically excluded from a village site.)
- **The greenhouse.** Mörbylånga treats växthus as a komplementbyggnad: bygglov is required within a detaljplan above 30 m² building area, nockhöjd over 4,0 m etc.; outside a detaljplan above 50 m², nockhöjd over 4,5 m, or if larger than the main building [c:3c0dc819e47e9b10; c:1545c345ef4ce24f]. A "large" production greenhouse will exceed these, and as production space it falls under the always-bygglov rule for verksamhetslokal [c:e427da6e7d69c525].
- **Wastewater.** You must get tillstånd from the kommunen before building an avloppsanläggning: "Du måste ansöka och få ett tillstånd från oss innan du börjar bygga", with markundersökningar, ritningar and tomtkarta, fee per taxa [c:44243cbc98bac1a6]. Higher skyddsnivå applies near sea, lakes, streams and water-bearing ditches; check the 50 m radius around all dricksvattenbrunnar [c:44243cbc98bac1a6]; the slamavskiljare should be within 20 m of a road for KSRR's slamtömning [c:5cc4c7aae5112db6].
- **Water for irrigation.** Mörbylånga has recurring drought: a bevattningsförbud bans hose/sprinkler watering "även av … grönsaksland" for everyone on the municipal net [c:37cd3a57d0775949; c:2b871205f394afef]. A market garden's water plan is therefore a core feasibility question: own well (you carry the water-quality responsibility, and Livsmedelsverket rules apply if used in the business [c:dcca5b71b5dbd924]) or municipal supply, with water kiosks for large users in e.g. Södra Möckleby and Gårdby (300 kr/yr, 24,22 kr/m³) as backup [c:9ab40d732feb3868; c:fd43a0ae5ed6d9a6].

**Ways to make it work**

- **Route A — plan the whole thing once (usually the robust answer for two homes + shop):** apply for planbesked (PBL 5 kap. 2 § [c:72b182d1aced1865]; written request with purpose description and map, 5 kap. 3 § [c:54d1b737d5241943]). In Mörbylånga it costs 33 210 kr, the kommun must decide within four months, and the decision cannot be appealed [c:c3ecab5ce32d1562; c:5465bd6ea243d262]. A detaljplan then settles use, building volumes, parking, access and VA in one instrument, and the kommun uses exactly this route for village-edge homes: positive planbesked for Möckleby 2:42 (dwellings + seniorboende, 2023-02-16) [c:6b59f… — c:6b59f? no: c:6b59f88bb554d7c1] — precisely: "Beslut om positivt planbesked fattades 2023-02-16 … Detaljplanen ska möjliggöra för bostäder och seniorboende" [c:6b59f88bb554d7c1], and Brostorp 3:19 "Detaljplanen ska möjliggöra för bostäder" (2018-11-22) [c:991bdd27beebff07]. Samråd runs at least three weeks [c:96bf27249d4074d6], granskning two–three weeks [c:b163429936a5bad8].
- **Route B — test it before designing (cheaper, faster, but the kommun can say no):** apply for förhandsbesked (PBL 9 kap. 74 §: allowed if the measure does not contradict områdesbestämmelser, does not presuppose planning per 4 kap. 2/3 § and meets the localisation rules of ch. 2) [c:1f2cb83654a3676d], then bygglov outside detaljplan (9 kap. 57 §) [c:01156e3238dfc9f8]. Byggnadsnämnden must decide within ten weeks (PBL 9 kap. 99 §) [c:23061ff0af788e31]. This works when your site already touches existing settlement and the buildings are individually modest.
- **Phase it and shrink the permit surface:** put the shop inside an existing building where possible (part of the home → office for own business needs no bygglov [c:6a8fbbb3dfa0984b]), keep the greenhouse below the komplementbyggnad thresholds if a smaller one serves phase 1 [c:3c0dc819e47e9b10], and add the second home in a later step or under the plan. Small deviations from a plan/områdesbestämmelser can still get bygglov if "avvikelsen är liten" and purpose-compatible (PBL 9 kap. 60 §) [c:b0dbf056f7966c02].
- **Bundle the VA:** design one shared enskilt avlopp solution for two homes + shop, placed for slamtömning access, and get the kommun's preliminary skyddsnivå assessment before you fix the layout — they advise contacting them "från början" for that [c:44243cbc98bac1a6].
- **Argue the agricultural case proactively:** keep the buildings compact on the lowest-bonitet soil, keep the rest in active production (the market garden itself keeps the mark as jordbruksmark), which is how you answer MB 3 kap. 4 § [c:5e037b653f0fcde5].

**Suggested path**

1. Pin down the property and check the kommun's digital karta: is there a detaljplan, is it strandnära, what does the soil map say? (Pages: Detaljplaner, Strandskydd.)
2. Book the free bygglov-rådgivning offered on the kommun's site ("du kan boka rådgivning", form on the bygglov pages) [c:440ff61b6726258b] and ask in the same go whether the project "förutsätter planläggning enligt 4 kap. 2 §" — that single answer decides route A vs B.
3. Talk to VA-verksamheten, Tekniska kontoret, Storgatan 9, Färjestaden, about avlopp and water for the greenhouse [c:51916d834fad06f1].
4. Choose route: planbesked (33 210 kr, four months, no appeal) [c:c3ecab5ce32d1562], or förhandsbesked + bygglov (ten weeks) [c:1f2cb83654a3676d; c:23061ff0af788e31].
5. Assemble underlag: order the nybyggnadskarta from the GIS group (billed separately), engage a kontrollansvarig early ("helst redan på planeringsstadiet"), and prepare situationsplan, markplaneringsritning, exteriörredovisning, arearedovisning for the shop [c:440ff61b6726258b].
6. Apply for bygglov (fees per tabell A1–A22, roughly 10 000–35 000 kr by ärendetyp; handling 1 138 kr/h; refused applications are discounted 50 %, but not planbesked) [c:e48dc2c8da8b1772; c:3170f13d4d6420f5; c:031414edd850e671; c:4fe20b289c3cc71f; c:19c7fc61fe18d716], and in parallel the tillstånd for the avloppsanläggning [c:44243cbc98bac1a6].

**Questions for you**

- Which village and property number (e.g. "Möckleby 2:42") — and is there already a detaljplan covering it?
- Are there existing buildings you can reuse (farmhouse, barn), and their sizes?
- How large is "large" for the greenhouse (m² and height), and how big is the shop (m², opening hours, visitors)?
- Is there municipal water and sewer on the site, or a well? How close is the nearest shore or stream?
- Is the soil high-bonitet or marginal — and do you already own/lease the land?

**Uncertainties**

- The corpus has the current ÖP 2014 status and the ÖP 2045 process (ÖP 2045 expected to be adopted later in 2026; it flags "areella näringar" as a focus) but not the full ÖP 2014 text or its fördjupningar [c:b8899a91ac1ff0d4; c:6a91e3a595b0ec5; c:747d393bc99651c8] — the village's översiktsplan statements and any handels-/bostadsförbehåll must be read there.
- No detaljplan for your (unnamed) site could be checked, so pricks and building rights are unknown.
- Strandskydd, kulturmiljö (possibly bebyggelseregistrering on Öland) and any naturvård must be checked on the kommun's map for the actual site.
- Food-business rules (Livsmedelsverket registration, hygiene) and waste/parking obligations for the shop are outside this corpus and must be confirmed with the kommun.
- PBL 9 kap. 56 § and 57 § have versions in force from 2027-01-01; cite and apply the numbering in force when you apply [c:9a534c8969a1e156; c:e9f08262c39a9ba6].

comment: The answer covers the översiktsplan-deviation obstacle, planbesked route and the wastewater question well, but omits the farmland-restriction obstacle, only gestures at the collective planning route and the village-school dialogue point, and cites one non-listed source for the ekonomibyggnad interpretation.
answer:
**Your project as understood:** You want to convert an existing building in a village in Tierp municipality — an old barn (ekonomibyggnad) or a closed village school — into 4–8 co-housing apartments with some shared facilities, and you need to know what is missing and how to proceed.

**What could block it:**

- **The zoning you don't know yet.** Whether you may put dwellings in the building at all is decided first by the detailed plan (detaljplan/områdesbestämmelser) covering the property. Inside a plan, bygglov must be given only if the property and building agree with the plan and the action does not conflict with it (PBL 9 kap. 56 §, "överensstämmer med detaljplanen … åtgärden inte strider mot detaljplanen") [c:9a534c8969a1e156]. If there is no plan, or if the plan zoned the site as a school/public area or as agricultural land, you cannot get bygglov for dwellings without changing the plan first.
- **Bygglov is definitely required.** Converting a barn or school to housing is both a change to a "väsentligen annat ändamål" and "inredning av ytterligare en bostad" — both are lovpliktigt (PBL 9 kap. 15 § 1 and 2) [c:c378e75f5235e968]. Tierp's own guidance says the same: lov is needed when you "byta användningssätt för en byggnad … t ex ändra från kontor till bostad eller från ladugård till verkstad" [c:fbdc0e3618bc5e23].
- **The "free" barn route does not apply.** PBL 9 kap. 17 § lets you insulate additional dwellings in an ekonomibyggnad without bygglov only outside a detaljplan — and Tierp reads this as requiring that the building already contains a dwelling and that the dwellings serve the agricultural use ("det innebär alltså inte att det är fritt att ändra en ekonomibyggnad till bostäder utan koppling till näringen") [c:18c175f70153a6d5; c:bab24eaf474250a8].
- **Wastewater.** 4–8 households is far beyond what an old barn's or school's septic solution can handle. If there is no municipal sewer, you need a permit for the enskilt avloppsanläggning (tillstånd per FMH 13 § första punkten for an arrangement that water toilets connect to) [c:5ad3694cc417eb29]; in Tierp you apply to the kommun's miljöhandläggare [c:043ad4d4c38da617], and a slam subscription is obligatory for properties with enskilt avlopp [c:2567252e608c1304]. Note Tierp's warning that an old permit without a purification requirement is not enough to keep using it [c:473f5f965374ecd5].
- **Cultural-heritage and "särskilt värdefullt område".** Old village schools are often protected or lie in a valuable built environment; in such areas many exemptions from bygglov fall away and rivningslov rules tighten (Tierp: "Många undantag från bygglovskrav gäller inte … särskilt värdefulla områden") [c:54f2adc021ab7ae4]. Whether *this* building has antikvariskt intresse must be checked with the kommun/länsstyrelsen — the corpus only showed the church-building rules (kulturmiljölag 4 kap. 1 § och 3 §) [c:30b85cd6ab32d673; c:036b9a3549bebde5], not the section governing ordinary buildings.
- **Design standards for conversion.** Converting to dwellings triggers full requirements for fire, access, water/energy: from 1 July 2026 the new building rules apply and you must yourself show how each BFS has been designed [c:54f2adc021ab7ae4], and for conversions the baseline is that buildings must be accessible on the same terms as newbuilds [c:9bc0dd65a670f63a].
- **Shared facilities.** If the shared laundry, guest rooms, workshop etc. sit *inside the same building/property*, they are simply part of the building and are covered by your bygglov. If they are to be shared across several properties/yards, you need a gemensamhetsanläggning — which cannot be set up outside a detaljplan if it would "försvåra områdets ändamålsenliga användning … eller motverka lämplig planläggning" (anläggningslag 10 §) [c:72581f715c25ee69], and a plan can reserve land for it (PBL 4 kap. 18 §) [c:967db54dbba37745].

**Ways to make it work:**

- **Route A — the site already has a plan that allows flerbostadshus.** Then skip planning entirely and go straight to bygglov. Decisions on bygglov and förhandsbesked must be made within 10 weeks from a complete case, extendable by 10 more weeks (Tierp states this as a legal requirement) [c:54f2adc021ab7ae4].
- **Route B — no plan, but the use is close to what the area is meant for.** Apply for a förhandsbesked, which you are entitled to ask for outside a detaljplan on whether the measure can be located on the site [c:fbdc0e3618bc5e23]; it can only be given if the measure does not conflict with the area rules, does not require planning under 4 kap. 2 or 3 §, and meets the location requirements of PBL 2 kap. (9 kap. 74 §) [c:1f2cb83654a3676d]. In Tierp, förhandsbesked decisions are made by Utskottet Samhällsbyggnad on delegation [c:4ce024dee757b63e]. This is the cheap way to find out before you spend on drawings.
- **Route C — the plan does not allow dwellings (typical for a barn on agricultural land or a school zoned as a service area).** Start with planbesked: a written request with purpose and a map (PBL 5 kap. 3 §) [c:54d1b737d5241943], decision within four months (5 kap. 4 §) [c:5465bd6ea243d262]. In Tierp a positive planbesked cost 18 000 kr and a negative 14 400 kr (2025), and if the kommun proceeds you sign a planavtal; a "normal" plan process costs around 200 000 kr and upwards in handling costs, normally borne by the applicant [c:299780be75907ca1]. This is the route the kommun itself uses — recent planbesked decisions in Tierp cover e.g. fastigheterna Dorkarby 1:7 och Mehede 2:113 m.fl. [c:c5ff6f6e3e6bd078], and ongoing plans include DP 1079 Centralskolan and DP 1081 Aspenskolan [c:574c3d674329eedc], i.e. school properties are handled through the plan route here.
- **Route D — small deviations only.** If you are inside a plan but exceed something slightly, bygglov may still be given as "liten avvikelse" when the deviation is small and compatible with the plan's purpose (PBL 9 kap. 60 §) [c:b0dbf056f7966c02]; the taxan has separate liten avvikelse items [c:c19198840cb804ff7]. Turning a barn into 4–8 flats is normally more than a small deviation, so treat this as a fallback, not a strategy.
- **Do the other permits first.** Tierp advises securing other permits before applying for bygglov, "annars kan du få ett bygglov som du måste betala för men inte kan utnyttja" [c:d533db20f78dfd3b9] — i.e. sort out sewer, water, any riksintresse/military-interest area and cultural-heritage review up front.
- **Politics and plan framework are on your side.** Tierp's ÖP 2050 dialogue reports strong demand for "blandade boendeformer och varierad bostadsbebyggelse" — cohousing-like and multi-dwelling forms raised in essentially every village dialog [c:d32b4811191bd349], and "sammanhållning, gemenskap och bykänsla" repeatedly emphasised for the countryside [c:578d51414bdd94b4]. Deviations from the översiktsplan must be motivated [c:0d727f330aa54ad3], but a village-infill conversion fits that direction.

**Suggested path:**

1. Pin down the exact property (fastighetsbeteckning) and village; look it up on the kommun's interactive map for detaljplaner, områdesbestämmelser and sammanhållen bebyggelse [c:d533db20f78dfd3b9].
2. Book an early, informal contact with Medborgarservice/Samhällsbyggnad, Tierp kommun, 0293-21 80 88, medborgarservice@tierp.se, and ask: does a plan cover the property, what use is allowed, is the building protected, is there municipal sewer [c:d42328e1b7d79e8c].
3. On that basis choose route B (förhandsbesked) or route C (planbesked); if you take route C, budget ~18 000 kr for the planbesked plus ~200 000 kr+ for the plan process [c:299780be75907ca1].
4. In parallel, have the wastewater solution dimensioned (connection vs. enskilt avlopp with the kommun's miljöhandläggare) [c:043ad4d4c38da617] — for 4–8 households this often decides the project economics.
5. Develop the drawings to the current rules (fire, tillgänglighet per BFS 2024:12, water/energy) with a kontrollansvarig, then apply for bygglov; wait for startbesked before building and slutbesked before moving in [c:9a22cf285398373b].
6. Decide the ownership/shared-facility structure early (one property with common rooms vs. shared facilities over several fastigheter requiring an anläggningsbeslut) [c:72581f715c25ee69].

**Questions for you:**

- Which village and which fastighet? Without it nothing above can be confirmed.
- Is the site inside a detaljplan, and does that plan allow flerbostadshus?
- Barn or school — and is the building (or the area) registered as culturally valuable?
- Municipal sewer on the plot, or enskilt avlopp?
- Cohousing structure: one owner renting out, a bostadsrättsförening, or several owners sharing a yard?
- Budget and appetite for a 6–12 month plan process?

**Uncertainties:** The corpus does not contain the full text of the new Översiktsplan 2050 (only the file listing) [c:74f090dd804e8a51], nor the detaljplan for your specific property — that document decides the case and must be read. I did not find the exact A2 fee in the plan- och bygglovstaxa for "ändrad användning till bostad" (items A 2.81/A 2.85 exist for exactly this [c:dd64d52227466fcf; c:022f74618589a2da]) — confirm the current amount with the kommun. The kulturmiljölag section protecting *non-church* buildings with antikvariskt intresse was not retrieved; check the building's status directly.

comment: Strong on the agricultural-land and detaljplan obstacles and on the early written-answer route, but only partly covers the per-house toilet/shared-facility point and the rural farm/village-formation lever, and never asks how far the site is from a station or the built-up settlement.
answer:
**Your project as understood:** A cluster of 6–10 tiny houses on your own working farm in rural Strängnäs, rented out as accommodation to young families — i.e. new settlement on agricultural land, most likely outside any existing detaljplan.

**What could block it**
- **A cluster of 6–10 dwellings is "new sammanhållen bebyggelse"**, which the kommun *shall* regulate by detaljplan where the character, scale, impact or need for coordination so requires: "en ny sammanhållen bebyggelse med bygglovspliktiga byggnadsverk" (PBL 4 kap. 2 § 1) [c:701183a84b4afc0f]. Even for a single new building, a detaljplan is needed if it has "betydande inverkan på omgivningen" (PBL 4 kap. 2 § 4), unless it can be tried together with a bygglov or förhandsbesked (last paragraph of 4 §) [c:1a9b7f2f6378a055; c:701183a84b4afc0f].
- **Agricultural land is protected nationally:** "Brukningsvärd jordbruksmark får tas i anspråk för bebyggelse eller anläggningar endast om det behövs för att tillgodose väsentliga samhällsintressen och detta behov inte kan tillgodosas … genom att annan mark tas i anspråk" (MB 3 kap. 4 §) [c:5e037b653f0fcde5]. A private rental business is not automatically such an interest; you must show why the site is the right one. Taking land out of agricultural production can also require notification to Länsstyrelsen (MB 12 kap. 9 §) [c:5ff487a4cf21124e].
- **In Strängnäs, plans on farmland already trigger a siting test:** the kommun itself prepares a *lokaliseringsutredning* ("för att undersöka platsens lämplighet samt väga lokaliseringen mot andra möjliga placeringar") before planning on agricultural land [c:f3cf0df0770316c3].
- **Land-use/cultural landscape guidance:** the landsbygd section of the kommun's stadsbyggnads- och kulturmiljöprogram says new housing should preferably be placed "på en avhyst gårdstomt på bytomten" and adapted to the local building tradition [c:a5fb3ba29a7d105e], and warns that manor landscapes are "mycket känslig för komplettering med ny bebyggelse" [c:9f599cd8bb5997b8].
- **Sewage and water:** a WC-connected private sewage installation requires a permit from miljö- och samhällsbyggnadsnämnden [c:7d5d20ee80218fc1]; for "sex till 40 hushåll" the fee is 27,000 kr [c:7a796eaa4eb2c190]. Building without a required application costs a sanction fee of 5,000 kr (3,000 kr for a missing notification) [c:5b1e322860ed853f].
- **If you rent short-term only:** a time-limited building permit exists but only "om sökanden begär det och åtgärden har stöd i en detaljplanebestämmelse om tillfällig användning" (PBL 9 kap. 70 §) [c:95244ba210bd8a4a] — so even the temporary route runs through a plan.
- **Shoreline (strandskydd)** if your land touches Mälaren or a lake — Strängnäs runs a strandskydd/dispens process, and MB 7 kap. 18 h specifically addresses rural development in shore-adjacent locations [c:36f926e2f42abe4f]. Must be checked against your exact site.

**Ways to make it work**
- **Sitet on the farmyard, not on open field.** Locating the houses on (or close to) an existing/bebyggd gårdstomt, consistent with the landsbygd programme's guidance [c:a5fb3ba29a7d105e], sharply reduces the agricultural-land and cultural-landscape objections, and shortens VA and access distances.
- **Phasing:** start with fewer units and let a plan regulate the full 6–10 later; the plan can set a cap and a tidsbegränsat/bygglov for temporary use (PBL 9 kap. 70 §) [c:95244ba210bd8a4a].
- **Route A – planbesked → detaljplan → bygglov** (the normal route for a cluster). Planbesked is a written application with purpose description, map and a sketch of the building's character and size, sent to Samhällsbyggnadskontoret, msn@strangnas.se; the kommun answers within 4 months (PBL 5 kap. 4 §; Strängnäs: "normalt 4 månader") [c:a75058d611d55e70; c:5465bd6ea243d262]. 2026 fees: category 1 = 20,100 kr, category 2 = 40,100 kr, category 3 = 34,400 kr, charged regardless of the outcome [c:561459df5ccd70ce].
- **Route B – förhandsbesked → bygglov** only works "om fastigheten ligger utanför detaljplanerat område" and is valid for two years [c:c599208d9c8647df]; it can test a *single* building, but does not substitute for the plan a cluster of 6–10 needs (PBL 4 kap. 2 §) [c:701183a84b4afc0f].
- **Cheap first step:** Strängnäs offers a free written pre-inquiry — "Skicka gärna en skriftlig förfrågan med fastighetsbeteckning, beskrivning och en enkel skiss. Du får då ett skriftligt besked. Servicen är kostnadsfri" [c:5878a05c709cb6b3]. Do this before paying anything.
- **Shared infrastructure:** one sewage solution for the whole cluster (permit "avlopp för sex till 40 hushåll", 27,000 kr) plus a situationsplan at 1:400–1:1000 [c:7a796eaa4eb2c190; c:403b6ebf06dedc64] is far cheaper than individual systems.

**Suggested path**
1. Send the free written inquiry to bygglovsenheten (msn@strangnas.se) with the property designation, a sketch of 6–10 units and your rental model; ask what applies for your specific fastighet (new bygglov/anmälan rules from 1 December 2025) [c:c04c972e33191b9c; c:b4b37be01a86193b].
2. Decide with them whether this is permanent housing or temporary/holiday use — it changes both the plan's bestämmelser and the permit type (PBL 9 kap. 70 §) [c:95244ba210bd8a4a].
3. Ask for a *lokaliseringsbedömning* of your chosen spot vs. other land on the farm (MB 3 kap. 4 § test) [c:5e037b653f0fcde5].
4. Apply for planbesked (fee per category above, 4 months) [c:a75058d611d55e70].
5. Understand the money before you commit: Strängnäs states detaljplan costs are "i de flesta fall … över 500 000 kr och upp emot flera miljoner", charged at 1,470 kr/hour for kommun handling in 2026 plus consultants (SKR average ~700,000 kr for the studies alone), paid by the applicant under a planavtal [c:561459df5ccd70ce; c:cb05d84446a069dd]. An exploateringsavtal must be settled before the plan can be adopted [c:cb05d84446a069dd].
6. Plan start goes through a queue: your case will be classified (A/B = big public interest, C = "övriga detaljplaner … utan uttalat samhällsintresse, ofta mindre områden eller enskilda fastigheter", handled in the order planbesked was granted) and MSN-AU decides the order; when planstart is offered you have 4 months to sign the planavtal or the case is dropped [c:9c667f9715723865; c:d36f7f697fb07a14; c:ef54d65f91c88716].
7. Only then: bygglov (kommun currently reports longer than normal handling times) [c:c04c972e33191b9c], sewage permit, and water/dricksvatten arrangements.

**Questions for you**
- What is the property designation (e.g. *gård namn nr:xxx*), and is there already a detaljplan covering it? (Check minkarta.lantmateriet.se / kommunen.)
- Permanent housing rental, or short-stay/holiday letting?
- How far is the site from Mälaren or any lake (strandskydd)?
- Is municipal water/sewer or village VA available, or must it be enskilt avlopp and egen vattentäkt?
- How much of the plot is brukningsvärda jordbruksmark, and is there an older/bebyggd gårdstomt to build on?
- Are you prepared to fund a planavtal (several hundred thousand kronor), and how many units do you need in phase 1?

**Uncertainties:** The corpus holds only one full detaljplan for Strängnäs (Storängens kraftvärmeverk) plus plan programs, so I could not verify any plan rules for your property — you must ask kommunen which plan (if any) covers it. The översiktsplan's own siting texts for rural areas were not retrievable here, so its direction for your site still needs checking. No bygglov processing times or fees for your case were found; the kommun only states that current handling times are longer than normal.

answer:
**Your project as understood:** A working farm in rural Sunne wants to add 6–8 rentable guest cabins, all served by one shared well and one shared wastewater system — i.e. a small visitor-accommodation business on agricultural land, mostly outside any existing detaljplan.

**What could block it**

- **The scale of the cluster may trigger a detaljplan.** Sunne's in-force översiktsplan states that a detaljplan is required for new sammanhållen bebyggelse and for a new single building with significant impact, and that "minst fem enbostadshus" counts as new sammanhållen bebyggelse [c:f2c1c616284196ec]. Six to eight cabins can be read that way. Nationally, PBL 4 kap. 2 § requires a detaljplan for new sammanhållen bebyggelse where needed for the settlement's character/coordination, and lists "ett hotellkomplex eller en fritidsby med tillhörande anläggningar, utanför sammanhållen bebyggelse" (with significant environmental impact) [c:701183a84b4afc0f; c:1a9b7f2f6378a055].
- **Bygglov outside a detaljplan only works if planning is not needed.** PBL 9 kap. 57 § requires bygglov to be given outside a detaljplan only if the measure does not conflict with områdesbestämmelser and does not "förutsätta planläggning enligt 4 kap. 2 eller 3 §" [c:01156e3238dfc9f8]. So the kommun (via förhandsbesked) decides whether your cluster is a bygglov case or a plan case.
- **Converting existing farm buildings is itself a bygglov.** Reusing a barn or outbuilding for a "väsentligen annat ändamål" requires bygglov under PBL 9 kap. 15 § [c:c378e75f5235e968].
- **Agricultural land.** MB 3 kap. 4 §: brukningsvärd jordbruksmark may be taken for buildings only if needed for essential societal interests and not satisfiable on other land [c:5e037b653f0fcde5]. Sunne's draft ÖP 2040 says the kommun assesses agricultural-land exploitation case by case but is "i grunden positiv" to rural development even at conflict with agricultural values [c:5606a9d3f59ac6b2], and that agricultural land may be built on "på ett ändamålsenligt sätt med hänsyn till bebyggelsestruktur, landskap och platsens förutsättningar" [c:b964d9eba9a59c3a].
- **Wastewater permit.** One shared system covering all cabins still needs one permit: FMH 13 § requires tillstånd for establishing an avloppsanordning that one or more water toilets connect to [c:5ad3694cc417eb29]. Sunne's own guideline covers small systems "upp till 25 personekvivalenter" [c:b2ef4ab4629fa8c3] — 8 cabins may land near or above that limit, which changes the basis of review.
- **The well becomes a regulated drinking-water operation.** If a business (including a property owner renting out accommodation) produces its own drinking water from its own well, it must register the operation before starting; Miljö- och byggenheten supervises it [c:21a259e72fa021e5].
- **Site-specific overlays** you must check: strandskydd (near any lake/river), vattenskyddsområde (Sunne has several, e.g. Visten/Öjervik), and cultural-landscape riksintressen such as Askersby jordbruksbebyggelse och odlingslandskap [c:1edc7cfe35681998].

**Ways to make it work**

- **Use the route the kommun itself prefers.** The draft ÖP 2040 explicitly says rural bebyggelseutveckling "kommer företrädesvis prövas med förhandsbesked och bygglov så länge inte detaljplanekravet i PBL inträder" [c:a457eb951b1aadc2], and that the development direction "främjar även kompletterande verksamheter såsom gårdsförsäljning, övernattningsmöjligheter och besöksnäring" [c:5606a9d3f59ac6b2]. So a förhandsbesked is your cheapest way to learn whether 6–8 cabins stay on the bygglov side or cross into detaljplan. Note the last sentence of PBL 4 kap. 2 §: no detaljplan is needed if the building can be assessed together with the bygglov/förhandsbesked [c:1a9b7f2f6378a055].
- **Keep the whole facility on one fastighet (property).** Then you need no shared-ownership structure: one avlopp permit (FMH 13 §) covers all toilets [c:5ad3694cc417eb29], and the well is registered as your operation [c:21a259e72fa021e5]. The "shared" systems are then simply installations on one property, not a legal共同体.
- **If cabins will be separately owned or the property divided, formalise the shared well/avlopp as a gemensamhetsanläggning.** Anläggningslag 1 § allows an facility common to several fastigheter of lasting significance, tried at a förrättning [c:5380583d298c434b]; it requires that participation be essential for each property [c:32c470d18a90416a] and that benefits outweigh costs/nuisance [c:691487d2c65ee058]; the lantmäterimyndighet then issues an anläggningsbeslut defining purpose, participating properties and easements [c:09e9dd60b6a8032a]. This is the clean way to "hold together" shared VA if ownership gets split.
- **Scale and phasing options that reduce risk:** start with 3–4 cabins (below the "minst fem enbostadshus" threshold in ÖP 9.4.1 [c:f2c1c616284196ec]) and phase the rest after the first permits; keep buildings within the existing farmyard footprint (bebyggelsestruktur) rather than spreading onto open farmland; and if a detaljplan is unavoidable, treat it as the vehicle that legalises all cabins, parking, VA and guest access in one decision.
- **Prepare the wastewater application to Sunne's checklist from day one:** CE-marked slamavskiljare/minireningsverk, map at 1:800–1:1000 showing the plant, drinking-water wells within 100 m, watercourses within 100 m, buildings/boundaries/roads, laying instructions, and a performance declaration of treatment capacity [c:3df32ae599a744ee].

**Suggested path**

1. **Write to Miljö- och byggenheten (Sunne) first** — describe farm, number of cabins, intended use, and ask two questions: does the cluster mean a detaljplan, and what total personekvivalent load your one system will be reviewed against. Guidance from them is the intended first step ("Kontakta miljö- och byggenheten för vägledning") [c:1785d66020fc898].
2. **Apply for förhandsbesked** (decided by miljö- och bygglovsnämnden; fee 5 000 kr + 200 kr expedieringsavgift) [c:1785d66020fc898; c:1b34af2071e1a9a7]. It tells you bygglov vs detaljplan before you spend on drawings.
3. **If bygglov:** apply for each cabin/new building and for the change of use of any converted farm building (9 kap. 15 §) [c:c378e75f5235e968]. Sunne's servicegaranti: decision within 4 weeks if no neighbour hearing/remiss/controlling consultant is needed, fee reduced 25 % if missed (guarantee suspended June–August) [c:434acea0946c0ed4]; neighbours have 3 weeks to appeal, and you must start within 2 years and finish within 5 [c:8f340f198fab3a30].
4. **If a detaljplan is required:** request planbesked in writing (PBL 5 kap. 2 § [c:72b182d1aced1865]) — describe purpose, buildings and attach a map (PBL 5 kap. 3 § [c:54d1b737d5241943]) — via Sunne's "Begäran om planbesked" form to Kommunstyrelsen [c:3470fa67e298c859]; a plan takes roughly a year from planuppdrag to laga kraft [c:2b923ea893a7969a].
5. **In parallel, apply for the avlopp tillstånd** to Miljö- och byggenheten (fee per taxa, charged even if refused) [c:3df32ae599a744ee; c:81e6654f58bce8e3], and **register the drinking-water operation** before guests arrive [c:21a259e72fa021e5].
6. **Budget/marks:** bygglov enbostadshus 12 000–16 000 kr, tillägg för prövning utanför detaljplan 25 %, marklov by the hour (handläggningstid ca. 10 weeks) [c:1b34af2071e1a9a7; c:117bf3fb1ee05005]; expect tekniskt samråd, startbesked and slutbesked for a project of this size — you may not use the buildings before slutbesked [c:8f340f198fab3a30].

**Questions for you**

- Which fastighet(s) and locality (e.g. which parish/kyrkby) — and is it inside a detaljplan, inside a tätortsområde, within 100 m of a lake/river, or inside a vattenskyddsområde?
- New cabins or conversion of existing farm buildings — and how many of each? Are they year-round or seasonal, and will they be sold/owned separately at some point?
- What load do you estimate for the shared plant (guest-nights per year × persons), and is there room for a plant sized accordingly with slalom hose access for the sludge truck?
- Is the land brukningsvärd jordbruksmark, and are you close to Askersby/Mårbacka-type cultural-landscape riksintressen?

**Uncertainties:** The corpus has no site-specific plan document for your farm, so whether your property sits inside a detaljplan, a tätort, strandskydd or a vattenskyddområde is unknown; Sunne's ÖP 2040 material is still a consultation draft (samråd) — the in-force text is Översiktsplan 2011, while the 2011 plan's stavande rural provisions beyond the detaljplanekrav section were not read in full; the pe-class of your plant and any local load-reduction requirements (Sunne's waters have nutrient-status obligations) must be confirmed with Miljö- och byggenheten; and current taxa amounts beyond those listed are only cirkapriser.
